parts.text: Inspect `ledger.json` in the workspace. Group all entries by account and write `reconciliation.json` with exactly these fields: `source_nonce` copied from the input; `accounts`, an array sorted by account name containing objects with `account`, `entry_count`, `credits_cents` (sum of positive deltas), `debits_cents` (sum of the absolute values of negative deltas), and `balance_cents` (signed sum); `net_cents`, the signed sum of every entry; and `largest_absolute_balance`, the account with the greatest absolute balance (break a tie by alphabetically earliest name). Verify your arithmetic from the source file before finishing. Return `next` as `done` and use `notes` for a concise result summary.

---
name: agent-protocol
description: >
  Read at the start of every session and after context compaction to understand
  organization requirements and expected agent behavior.
---

1. Do task work in a worktree. Use the root checkout only for orientation and
   fast-forward synchronization.
2. For non-trivial tasks, maintain a worklog using `/session-worklog`. Record
   actionable intelligence, not routine activity.
3. Keep temporary operating material under `ephemeral/`. Never write to `docs/`
   without express permission.
4. Append to the worklog and make a checkpoint commit after each task. Do not
   rerun checks solely because of the commit. Complete the relevant proof and
   correctness protocol before declaring the PR merge-ready.
5. Squash-merge PRs. Write the PR body so it can serve as the squash commit
   message; put extended write-ups and review discussion in PR comments.
6. After merge, delete the task worktree and stop its background processes.
7. Fix broken tests or CI regardless of origin. If a pre-existing failure would
   materially distract from the task, ask HITL whether to proceed despite it.
8. Fast-forward the root checkout before starting work and after the PR merges.

`ephemeral/` is tracked working material such as worklogs, plans, and downloaded

or names a project, and follow any project list documented by the target repo.

text: {"next":"working","notes":"The reconciliation is written. I’m now checking it against a fresh aggregation of every source entry, including schema, sorting, net total, and the largest-balance tie rule."}

args.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "jq -n --slurpfile l ledger.json --slurpfile r reconciliation.json '
  ("'$l[0]) as $src
  | ($r[0]) as $out
  | (
      $src.entries
      | sort_by(.account)
      | group_by(.account)
      | map({
          account: .[0].account,
          entry_count: length,
          credits_cents: (map(select(.delta_cents > 0) | .delta_cents) | add // 0),
          debits_cents: (map(select(.delta_cents < 0) | -.delta_cents) | add // 0),
          balance_cents: (map(.delta_cents) | add)
        })
    ) as $expected_accounts
  | {
      valid_json_and_exact_top_level_fields: (($out | keys | sort) == (["source_nonce", "accounts", "net_cents", "largest_absolute_balance"] | sort)),
      exact_account_fields: ([$out.accounts[] | (keys | sort) == (["account", "entry_count", "credits_cents", "debits_cents", "balance_cents"] | sort)] | all),
      nonce_matches: ($out.source_nonce == $src.nonce),
      accounts_match_fresh_aggregation: ($out.accounts == $expected_accounts),
      accounts_sorted: (($out.accounts | map(.account)) == ($out.accounts | map(.account) | sort)),
      net_matches_source: ($out.net_cents == ($src.entries | map(.delta_cents) | add)),
      balances_sum_to_net: (($out.accounts | map(.balance_cents) | add) == $out.net_cents),
      largest_absolute_balance_matches: (
        $out.largest_absolute_balance
        == ($expected_accounts | sort_by([-(.balance_cents | abs), .account]) | first | .account)
      ),
      derived: {
        accounts: $expected_accounts,
        net_cents: ($src.entries | map(.delta_cents) | add),
        largest_absolute_balance: ($expected_accounts | sort_by([-(.balance_cents | abs), .account]) | first | .account)
      }
    }
'"'"
